art_direction: 低矮青黑山脊托住一轮淡月，山脚只有薄雾与两笔松影。
composition: one original focal subject, centered and readable within a circular avatar crop
creative_direction: Show a low mountain ridge as one broad blue-black ink shape across the lower third. Above it, a pale full moon is formed by a soft reserved paper disc, slightly off center. Place two tiny pine silhouettes on the ridge but keep them subordinate to the mountain curve. A mist band gently separates the ridge from its faint lower reflection. Work with three tonal values and restrained bleeding at the wet edges. Keep the sky completely open and quiet. Create a square 1024x1024 avatar with a clear central silhouette that remains legible at thumbnail size. Use an original text-only composition, without lettering, logos, signatures, or watermarks.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
visual_review: passed: compressed preview inspected for clear original focal composition, requested medium and detail level, circular-crop readability, no unintended anatomy or rendering defects, no text or watermark
